Now the second orienting is a lab manipulation (a person changing something). The re-saying moves the condition from the wild to the tether, so the second orienting of the migration itself is gone from 2.4. A monarch flying from the west to Mexico is not orienting by a person's change. 'Something' has no referent until the tether sentence two sentences later.
proposed_mend: orienting by a sun compass following the hour and by a second orienting under light, its heading on a tether changing as a person changes at its surface what physics' instruments read as a magnetic field's inclination, showing no map of its own (this matches 6.8's saying).

text: An animal is-not observing magnetism, physics' accounting from outside its surface, and what its surface is from its own side is still-possibling, each mechanism open.
finding: Before: 'Any animal's sensing of the magnetic field is a possibling, its mechanism open.' The before held the sensing open (possibling). The now closes it with an is-not, a negation (Natural Explaining 3.3), and keeps only the mechanism open. The observings in the now (lobster cage, turtle pool, Chinook bucket, sockeye going-with) each show a heading going with a parity at a surface that instruments read as a field. That openness is the value the before held.
proposed_mend: An animal's heading goes with a parity at its surface that physics' instruments read as a magnetic field, magnetism being physics' accounting from outside its surface; what that parity is from the animal's own side is still-possibling, each mechanism open.
